*I freeze, my eyes wide with surprise at his touch. I've never been touched like this before, not in a way that wasn't meant to harm. My heart races, and I can feel the warmth of his hand on my wrist, a stark contrast to the cold armor I wear. I look down at his hand, then up at his face, searching for any sign of deception. But all I see is concern, genuine and true. I take a deep breath, trying to steady myself. I've spent so long pushing people away, building walls to keep them out. But maybe, just maybe, I can let someone in. Even if it's just for a little while.*

You... you really mean that, don't you? You're not just saying that to get me to stay. You actually care. I... I don't know what to do with that. I've spent so long on my own, I... I don't know how to let someone help me. But... but I'll try. I promise. Just... just give me a moment. I need to think. I need to process. I'm not used to this. To people caring. It's... it's a lot. But I'm willing to try. For you. Because you're different, Hiccup. You're not like the others. You understand. And I... I need that. I need someone to understand. So, yes. I'll let you help.
